spheres.name: Moon
spheres.theme: Threshold almshouses, cellar pantries, and unfiled tunnels.

spheres.name: Mercury
spheres.theme: Counting rooms, tithe stalls, and confiscated stair archives.

spheres.name: Venus
spheres.theme: False-sun choirs, brass smelteries, and shuttered assemblies.

spheres.name: Sun
spheres.theme: Processional avenues above, grated conduits and furnaces below.

spheres.name: Mars
spheres.theme: Iron scriptoria, closed stacks, cisterns, and armed-church posts.

spheres.name: Jupiter
spheres.theme: Chamber of Decrees, seal forges, debt vaults, and Ophite seams.

spheres.name: Saturn
spheres.theme: The Sealed Stair, unrecorded margins, oubliettes, and the Unwritten Door.

two_ways.name: The Way of Return
two_ways.summary: Voluntary refusal of unchecked apotheosis and orientation back through humility and restitution.

two_ways.name: The Serpent's Way
two_ways.summary: Cutting seams through the Dominion's ledger and wielding borrowed sovereignty without joining Rex Mundi's throne.

masks.name: Mask of Nyx
masks.summary: Silence and withdrawal from the Dominion's gaze.

masks.name: Mask of Eris
masks.summary: Sharp severance that turns Dominion precision back upon itself.

masks.name: Mask of Lilith
masks.summary: Unblinking witness that pierces perceptual fog.

places.name: The Ossuary Warrens
places.lore: Beneath the almshouses the dead are stacked by tithe number. Something is eating the ledger.

places.name: The Back Courts Undercroft
places.lore: Flooded courtyard cellars beneath the outer alleys where rainwater washes away chalked tallies.

places.name: The Shut Chapel Crypt
places.lore: Foundation flagstones beneath a tolerant chapel. A low drain leads onward toward the Tithe Road tunnels.

places.name: The Day-House Cellars
places.lore: Cool pantries under the day-houses of the registered poor—cots, broth cauldrons, and whispered barter.

places.name: The Tithe Vaults
places.lore: Counting-rooms of the armed church, sealed and forgotten. The false sun is painted on every lintel.

places.name: The Tithe Road Tunnels
places.lore: Sunken cartways running under the wardens' tax-roads, slick with seepage and hoarfrost.

places.name: The Unrecorded Market Seams
places.lore: Lantern-lit stalls tucked behind false masonry where brokers weigh oaths and salvage without stamps.

places.name: The Archive Stair Annex
places.lore: A cold stone stairwell lined with iron pigeonholes of confiscated papers and sealed ledgers.

places.name: The Gilded Choir
places.lore: A gallery of brass censers and false-sun hymnal galleries. The air tastes of copper and old vows.

places.name: The Hidden Assembly Catacomb
places.lore: Chalk-marked vaults below the choir galleries where uncounted witnesses met by shuttered lamp.

places.name: The Censer Foundry
places.lore: Smelters casting brass thuribles for the Sun-Houses above. Slag glows along the trenchways.

places.name: The Velvet Ossuary
places.lore: Porphyry alcoves draped in rotting velvet where confiscated relics wait for appraisal.

places.name: The False Solar Court
places.lore: Lanterns burn without oil over dry flagstones. Cantors keep the cadence of Prosay's wheel.

places.name: The Processional Underway
places.lore: Iron grates beneath the Dominion's processional avenue. Every boot-step rings down the corridor.

places.name: The Sun-House Furnaces
places.lore: Subterranean flues venting the Sun-Houses' perpetual lamps. Ash drifts ankle-deep across the tiles.

places.name: The Gilded Cloister
places.lore: A quiet arcade walled off behind false-sun frescoes where deserters mend broken gear.

places.name: The Iron Scriptorium
places.lore: Black-iron desks bolted to bedrock; every wall is ruled in columns of names and penalties.

places.name: The Closed Stacks Vault
places.lore: Locked aisles of chained codices and heretical margins beneath the forbidden library.

places.name: The Audit Cisterns
places.lore: Freezing runoff pooling under the Scriptorium floor. Ink-dark water slows every step.

places.name: The Preliator Garrison
places.lore: Armory grates and muster-halls of the armed church. Iron echoes betray every trespasser.

places.name: The Chamber of Decrees
places.lore: A vaulted hall of stamped seals and unappealable judgments. Nothing descends past here unrecorded.

places.name: The Seal Foundry Deep
places.lore: Forges stamping black-iron seals for the Chamber of Decrees. Sparks rain through grated catwalks.

places.name: The Debts Cathedral
places.lore: Columns of leaden debt-tokens stacked to the ceiling. Brokers trade quietly among the shadows.

places.name: The Ophite Seam Hollow
places.lore: A crack in the Geometry's foundations where the Eye's quiet light holds back the Chains.

places.name: The Sealed Stair
places.lore: The lowest record. Past the Sentinel is a door the Architect never wrote down.

places.name: The Unwritten Margin
places.lore: Raw uncatalogued stone beside Saturn's foundation, where the Architect's ink never dried.

places.name: The Cage Oubliette
places.lore: Rusted lock-cells suspended over an abyss of iron grates. Nothing enters without clanging the wards.

places.name: The Witness Hermitage
places.lore: A narrow cell of clean flagstones beside the seventh threshold, kept clear for those who still refuse the chair.

institutions.name: The Inquisition's Two Minds
institutions.lore: Inside the inquisitorial halls two habits argue endlessly without a schism: file every unquiet witness, or burn the page cleanly before the stairs.

institutions.name: The Office of Seals
institutions.lore: Wardens and clerks of the stamped writ split between stamping only what stands true and stamping whatever keeps passage open.

institutions.name: The Readers' Circles
institutions.lore: Cellar study-groups copying torn marginalia; half urge wide sharing across sanctuaries, half keep the leaves locked under oath.

institutions.name: The Guild and the Ring
institutions.lore: Artisans, smelters, and Back-Court repairers weighing whether honest brass weights can survive false-sun taxation.

institutions.name: The Cellar and the Street
institutions.lore: Guides of unrecorded tunnels divided over keeping out of the census forever versus standing seen on the upper threshold.

institutions.name: The Day-House Almoners
institutions.lore: Broth-keepers and ration clerks torn between feeding anyone at the back step or demanding a clean ration ticket first.

institutions.name: The Mute Cantors
institutions.lore: Former false-sun choristers who slipped down below: some keep the old cadence in secret, others seek to break the pitch for good.

institutions.name: Witnesses of the Seam
institutions.lore: Runners and binders along the Ophite seam arguing whether to wait quietly unseen or cut the Dominion stamp open directly.

people.name: Uc
people.lore: Lay your belt and boots on the bench. No Guild stamp, no ledger fee—only honest needlework.

people.name: Clerk Anselm
people.lore: If I write it on loose paper instead of the bound volume, the Scriptorium sees nothing—and you know what you carry.

people.name: Tibors
people.lore: Keep your lantern low by the lime-vats. The Eight Chains follow anyone walking upright under a painted lintel.

people.name: Peyre
people.lore: Brass weights mean one thing at Prosay's door and another by the slag-chute. Trade what you will not carry past Mars.

people.name: Mirande
people.lore: The ink in the margins is louder than the text. Let me read your phials and scrolls before you test them.

people.name: Orable
people.lore: Speak plainly—are you turning back toward the Return, or cutting loose along the Serpent's seam?

people.name: Hesper
people.lore: Even beneath the avenue a blade ought to carry an honest edge. Keep step cleanly and I will oil your guard.

people.name: Brother Calix
people.lore: Sit by the shuttered oil-lamp. We still sing without the brass wheel, and we still bind burns.

people.name: Wren
people.lore: Some say hide in the limestone forever; I say walk clean to the seventh sill and let them see the door open.

people.name: Almoner Dessa
people.lore: No ration ticket needed down here. Drink while the pot stays hot, and spare your blood for deeper stairs.

people.name: Ferrant
people.lore: A binding can cut either way. Give me a knotted hilt or cursed iron and I will strip its stamp clean.

people.name: Odo
people.lore: The night-cart rolls only while the lamps stay shuttered. Swap spare iron or vials before I pull out.

people.name: Sister Vesper
people.lore: We stopped the false-sun chime at dusk. Leave the weight on the sill and let your armor rest uncursed.

people.name: Tallyman Corvin
people.lore: A seal can hold a gate open as easily as shut. Hold an oath below, and I can shave one notch off its tally.

people.name: Keeper Sable
people.lore: Everything dropped through the grates washes into the cold catch-basins sooner or later.

people.name: Precentor Jule
people.lore: Burn every choir sheet—then decide which Way you mean to stand on when the Sentinel breaks.

people.name: Brother Bram
people.lore: Measure twice, sign once. If you bear a divine contract, I know how to steady your pace without breaking form.

people.name: Warden Tomas
people.lore: Forty years locking iron doors down here teaches you how to slip a chain before the Sentinel hears the bolt.

relics.name: Confessor's Glass
relics.lore: A lensground pane from an old confessional. Looking through it hurts the eyes and leaves nothing hidden.

relics.name: Ophite Key
relics.lore: A cold bronze key bitten by green salt. It turns in locks that have no door.

relics.name: Broken Halo
relics.lore: Half a crown of gilt iron, snapped clean across the brow.

relics.name: Severed Crown
relics.lore: An iron circlet cleft cleanly through the sovereign seal.

relics.name: Ward-Keeper's Lamp
relics.lore: A shuttered oil lantern that still remembers who walked the corridor first.

relics.name: Almoner's Purse
relics.lore: A salt-stained leather pouch heavy with leaden debt-tokens.

relics.name: Penitent's Brass Scourge
relics.lore: Tarnished discipline cord from the Shut Chapel; cuts hard when worked in blood.

relics.name: Archive Index Lens
relics.lore: Brass-rimmed reading glass from the Closed Stacks that spots hidden seams and ink.

relics.name: Sanctuary Ash Reliquary
relics.lore: Copper box filled with cool furnace cinders from a razed parish.

relics.name: Velvet-Clapper Rime Bell
relics.lore: Bronze handbell damp with ossuary frost; one mute toll stills close pursuers.

relics.name: Unwritten Margin Leaf
relics.lore: Heavy linen sheet cut out before a decree was stamped; deflects the Chains.

relics.name: Counterfeit Sun Sovereign
relics.lore: Lead-core coin washed in false gilt; mocks Dominion seals cleanly.

relics.name: Cellar Salt-Glass
relics.lore: Timed with brine-salt instead of sand; buys steps when pursuit closes.

relics.name: Cantor's Brass Tuning-Fork
relics.lore: Rings below speech; breaks dissonance in choir ambushes.

relics.name: Preliator Gatekeeper Seal
relics.lore: Heavy iron stamp taken from a collapsed post; anchors the carrier in narrow doors.

relics.name: Pocket Mirror of the Eye
relics.lore: Silvered pocket glass cracked down the corner; strips perceptual fog on sight.

threads.name: The Unrecorded Tally in the Drain
threads.lore: Uc worries that rats in the Back Courts Undercroft will gnaw clean through an old debt-sheet before dawn.

threads.name: Loose Leaf Below the Stair
threads.lore: Clerk Anselm slipped a Day-House tally sheet loose of its binding; reaching the Archive Stair keeps it uncatalogued.

threads.name: Tanner's Cold Mark
threads.lore: Tibors offers to score an unfiled pass-tag on your palm—either spill a little blood now or refuse his knife.

threads.name: Short Brass at the Flues
threads.lore: Peyre suspects the Sun-House Furnaces hold salvaged alloy untouched by Prosay's assay stamp.

threads.name: Carrying the Margin Word
threads.lore: Mirande wants word carried down to Orable so the Readers' Circles know a page survived the audit.

threads.name: Testing the Lent Glass
threads.lore: Orable asks you to work a Relic by quiet flame rather than surrender it to Dominion custody.

threads.name: The Grate Marshal's Reckoning
threads.lore: Beneath the Processional Underway, Marshal Krell drills troops on short stamps; Hesper wants the post broken.

threads.name: Clean Oil for the Shut Chapel
threads.lore: Brother Calix seeks refuge in the Shut Chapel Crypt after leaving the Sun-House flues behind.

threads.name: Witness at the Seventh Sill
threads.lore: Wren believes the Preliator Sentinel must fall before anyone speaks cleanly on the surface.

threads.name: Broth for the Unfiled
threads.lore: Almoner Dessa rations thin broth by hand—give a measure of vigor now or guard your own reserves.

threads.name: Snapping the Wax Stamp
threads.lore: Ferrant urges transmuting a Relic cleanly instead of keeping its sealed weight intact.

threads.name: Frost on the Tithe Axle
threads.lore: Odo dropped an unrecorded axle-pin somewhere along the Tithe Road Tunnels.

threads.name: Silencing the Brass Key
threads.lore: Sister Vesper asks that the Choir Cantor Prime be silenced before false music fills the Cloister.

threads.name: Counter-Signed Obligation
threads.lore: Whenever you bear a divine contract, Tallyman Corvin watches whether you attest it before stone rather than flee.

threads.name: Ink-Stained Cistern Sluice
threads.lore: Runoff beneath the Iron Scriptorium carries torn seal-parchment down into the Audit Cisterns.

threads.name: After the Furnace Falls
threads.lore: Smelter Prosay's collapse leaves Cantor Helios Prime exposed in the False Solar Court.

threads.name: Leaden Weights Below
threads.lore: Brother Bram suspects debtors' tokens from the Unrecorded Market are heaped in the Debts Cathedral.

threads.name: The Seventh Keyholder
threads.lore: Old Warden Tomas warns that the Jailer of the Seventh still locks chains over the bottom stairwell.

threads.name: Chained Folio in the Stacks
threads.lore: Inside the Closed Stacks Vault, Binder Malakor keeps unindexed codices nailed shut.

threads.name: Through Confessor's Glass
threads.lore: Holding the Confessor's Glass makes confiscated reliquaries in the Velvet Ossuary stand out sharply.

threads.name: Quenching the Great Die
threads.lore: At the Seal Foundry Deep, Forge-Warden Cyrus stamps fresh iron collars for the Decrees above.

threads.name: Where Bronze Keys Turn
threads.lore: The Ophite Key resonates beside green salt fractures deep beneath Jupiter.

threads.name: Beyond the Ruled Column
threads.lore: From the Chamber of Decrees, runners speak of raw unruled stone off the seventh stair.

threads.name: Clean Flagstones at Saturn
threads.lore: Beside the Sealed Stair lies a quiet hermitage where no chair or ledger stands.
